name.description: The name of the Dataflow job. Must be unique within the project.
name.rationale: Job names are identifiers and do not impact security.

template_gcs_path.description: The Google Cloud Storage path to the Dataflow job template.
template_gcs_path.rationale: Template location does not impact security directly.

temp_gcs_location.description: A Google Cloud Storage path for temporary files used during job execution.
temp_gcs_location.rationale: Temporary data may contain sensitive information and should be stored securely.

parameters.description: Job parameters passed to the pipeline. Case-sensitive and language-dependent. Do not configure Dataflow options here.
parameters.rationale: Parameters are for pipeline logic, not security settings.

labels.description: Key/value pairs for organizing and identifying resources. See [labeling restrictions](https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/labeling-resources#restrictions).
labels.rationale: Labels are for organization and do not impact security.

terraform_labels.description: Combined labels from the resource and provider defaults.

effective_labels.description: All labels present on the resource in GCP, including those set by Terraform and other clients.

transform_name_mapping.description: Mapping of transform names for template jobs.

max_workers.description: Maximum number of workers to use for the job.

on_delete.description: Action to take on job deletion (e.g., drain, cancel).
on_delete.rationale: Job deletion policy does not impact security.

skip_wait_on_job_termination.description: If true, Terraform will not wait for job termination.

project.description: The GCP project in which the job will run.
project.rationale: Project selection does not impact job security directly.

zone.description: The zone in which the job will run (if applicable).
zone.rationale: Zone selection does not impact security directly.

region.description: The region in which the job will run.
region.rationale: Region selection does not impact security directly.

service_account_email.description: The email address of the service account to run the job.
service_account_email.rationale: Service account permissions control job access to resources.

network.description: The VPC network to which the Dataflow job will connect.
network.rationale: Restricting jobs to approved networks is critical for data security and compliance.

subnetwork.description: The subnetwork to which the Dataflow job will connect.
subnetwork.rationale: Restricting jobs to approved subnetworks is critical for data security and compliance.

machine_type.description: The type of machine to use for workers.
machine_type.rationale: Machine type affects performance, not security.

kms_key_name.description: The Cloud KMS key to use for encrypting Dataflow job resources.
kms_key_name.rationale: Using a customer-managed key ensures control over encryption.

ip_configuration.description: The IP configuration for the Dataflow job (e.g., WORKER_IP_PRIVATE).
ip_configuration.rationale: Private IPs restrict public access to workers, improving security.

additional_experiments.description: List of additional experiments to enable for the job.
additional_experiments.rationale: Experiments are for feature testing, not security.

enable_streaming_engine.description: Enable the Dataflow Streaming Engine for the job.
enable_streaming_engine.rationale: Streaming Engine is a performance feature, not a security control.
